name: BM25Plus
applicable_conditions: BM25Plus is only applicable when the repository contains the _score_idf_bm25plus and _score_tfc_bm25plus functions in bm25s/scoring.py.
The method is applicable only when the corpus is in JSONL format as specified by the JsonlCorpus class in bm25s/utils/corpus.py.
limitations: The method does not support English language input as the current bm25s implementation only supports English.
The method relies on the existing bm25s library and cannot be used independently without the underlying scoring functions.
